''See also: [[Fisher Gesha Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Fisher Gesha, also known as Gesha, is a [[Highgold]] [[Soulsmith]] originally from the [[Desolate Wilds]]. She is characterized by her diminutive, heavily wrinkled appearance and gray hair styled in a tight bun. For mobility and to reach high places, she utilizes a [[drudge]] [[construct]] consisting of eight mechanical purple spider legs that extend from beneath her robes. She often carries a large [[goldsteel hook]] or sickle on her back, which is nearly as big as her body. As a skilled [[Soulsmith]], Gesha possesses expertise in working with [[binding|bindings]] and [[constructs]], treating them with the precision of a blacksmith. Her professional history includes running businesses in [[Stormrock]] and operating a mobile [[Soulsmith foundry]] shaped like a barn, which she moved through the [[Blackflame]] camp to provide services. She has served as a mentor to [[Lindon]], assisting with his training and the development of his [[madra]] control. Despite her irritable and disapproving demeanor, Gesha shows deep devotion to her family. She has been recognized for her distinction in service, even standing against an enemy [[Underlord]], which led to her being rewarded with the rank of [[Truegold]] by the Emperor. Throughout her journey, she has transitioned from a remote artisan to an honored guest and respected figure within larger political and military circles.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Fisher Gesha is a four-foot-tall, shrunken [[old woman]] with a wrinkled face and gray hair tied into a bun. She possesses eight long, purple mechanical spider legs made of [[Forged madra]] in place of her feet.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|A soft-hearted elder and [[Sage]], Gesha is a business owner who has offered her life to atone for her past actions. She serves as a tutor and advisor, working closely with [[Lindon]] to study armor and [[constructs]].}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Fisher Gesha serves as a tutor to [[Lindon]], with whom she has traveled and studied. She has also examined [[scripts]] alongside [[Eithan]] and [[Lindon]], and was brought by [[Eithan]] for her talents. Additionally, Gesha follows [[Renfei]], was woken by the shouts of [[Naru Cassias Arelius|Cassias]], and requested that [[Seisha]] work on a festival display.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|As a [[Highgold]] [[Soulsmith]], Gesha utilizes [[purple madra]] to manipulate objects, pull heavy doors shut, and lash lines to debris. She can also throw a web of purple light and uses a Goldsteel{{!}}goldsteel-plated fishhook as a weapon.}}

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Fisher Gesha|Gesha]] asked [[Seisha]] to work on a welcoming display for the [[Seven-Year Festival]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|“Of course,” Lindon said, thinking of the scales he had Forged for Fisher Gesha.<ref name="cradle-03-blackflame-c10" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|“Underlord or no Underlord, if you’re walking into my place of business and telling me to clear out—”<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c8" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|“I have said so many insolent things to the Sage, hmm?” Fisher Gesha said. “This old woman can only atone for her actions, and protect her family, by offering her life.”<ref name="cradle-11-dreadgod-c21" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“I just wanted your permission to use the Soulsmithing facilities in those tunnels!<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|“Gesha asked me to work on the welcoming display for the Seven-Year Festival next year,” Seisha said.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c32" />}}
